verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a native MCP server at POST /mcp. Through it, MCP clients can create indexes, add documents, configure settings and run searches via prompts (meilisearch-docs-79, docs-13, docs-57). Everything is also exposed through a single API with typed SDKs and a curl-installable binary, so an agent can work end to end without a dashboard (docs-1, docs-50, docs-12). The llms.txt and markdown docs probes further support agent use. missing for 10: no dedicated CLI evidenced, no published OpenAPI spec found (probe 404), no independent hands-on report of an agent driving the full create/ingest/query flow via MCP.
